findings.title: init's version_missing refusal tells the person to run `norn init`
findings.detail:
On a team file with no norn_version, init refuses with D4's missing-version do_instead, which begins `run \`norn init\` if norn was never set up here`. Coming from init itself that first clause loops back; the 0.30 path that AC3 asks for follows it, so AC3 holds. The text is D4's and D1 says nothing else words it, so this is a wording question for the person, not rework.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: If the person wants it, a later change could give init only the 0.30 path for version_missing; otherwise leave it.
